description: This file defines the KeycloakUserService class, which manages user operations such as create, update, read by email, and read by ID using Keycloak's admin client API.

classes.name: KeycloakUserService
classes.description: Service class for managing Keycloak users, providing methods to create, update, and retrieve users.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user in Keycloak and returns the HTTP response status code.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates an existing user in Keycloak.

methods.name: readUserByEmail
methods.description: Searches for users by email in Keycloak, returning a list of UserRepresentation objects.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their authentication ID; throws EntityNotFoundException if not found.
